content: The “GID” of a vehicle identification response/vehicle announcement message shall contain the value retrieved by the configured DoIPGetGID function, if the configuration parameter DoIPVinGIDMaster is set to fal se and the parameter DoIPGID is not configured. If the function does not return E_OK, the GID shall consist of 6 Bytes according to the configured DoIPGIDInvalidityPattern.
